Other words

  • fābula scaenica

    also used · post-classical · Traupman 53, 361; M-O s.v. play, drama; Amm. 28.1.4 (Lewis & Short, s.v. scaenicus)

  • drāma, drāmatis n. — a drama, a play

    noun, third declension · also used · late Latin · Aus. Ep. 18.15 (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. play, drama

    The Greek word; Latin has it first in Ausonius. The classical word is fābula.
